newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Caltex to sell 40 pct stake in Bahrain refinery.
newsitem.headline: Caltex to sell 40 pct stake in Bahrain refinery.

text.p: Caltex, the Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp joint venture, will sell its 40 percent stake in Bahrain's Sitra refinery in April, the Gulf News Agency reported on Wednesday.
"Bahrain and Caltex have signed a letter of intent for Caltex to sell its 40 percent stake in BAPCO's refinery to the Bahraini government as of April 1," the agency added.
The agency quoted Oil and Industry Minister Sheikh Isa bin Ali al-Khalifa as saying Bahrain would refine and market all of its oil products from April 1.

Bahrain Petroleum Company (BAPCO) runs the 250,000 barrels per day (bpd) Sitra oil refinery which is a major exporter of petroleum products such as middle distaillates to Middle East, Africa, Indian sub-continent and Asian markets.
BAPCO is 60 percent owned by the Bahrain government.
Caltex will remain the technical services supplier to the oil refinery, Sheikh Isa said.
The Bahraini government and Caltex have been studying plans over the past six years to modernise the refinery, built in 1936.
Last year, a committee was formed to review a four-year-old feasibility study to modernise the refinery and produce higher value products, including lead-free gasoline.
Bahrain, a small independent oil producer, imports around 200,000 bpd of crude from Saudi Arabia for refining.
It produces around 40,000 bpd from its own fields.
